claim: minimum cars over the union of the GA and per-wave exact menus; never above the GA-menu result (when both runs are optimal); not a global day optimum (EQ3)

cpsat.rerun_rule: a union run that stopped on its time limit (feasible or indeterminate) is re-run once at the re-run limit; a proven infeasibility is final

menu_rules.dedupe: exact options are never deduped against GA options; deduped among themselves only when partition, stop order and per-route minutes are identical (first kept)
